verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it offers APIs to connect the virtual mailbox to other tools and keep documents and mail in sync. That is a first-party API, but nothing shows how much of the UI it covers. Missing for 10: API reference documentation, evidence of UI-to-API parity (e.g. forwarding, check deposit, junk filtering, AI labels, multi-user access via API), authentication/developer docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
